Case study · Own product

BARVIS Focus Focus that stays tied to the goal.

Problem
A timer in one app, tasks in another, notes in a third. You could not see where the time went.
Solution
A timer tied to a project and task, a day plan, analytics by day, week and month, and skill levels that grow with time invested.
Stack
Django, PostgreSQL, Docker; private server.

BARVIS Focus is my own product, not a client project. It shows how I build a complex system end to end: sync across devices, keyboard-only use and analytics.

41 seconds through the system: timer, tasks, day plan, analytics, growth and phone. Fictional data.

Focus that stays tied to the goal.

  1. On the phone.

    The same timer carries on where it stopped on the desktop.

  2. Analytics.

    Time per day and project, compared with the previous period.

  3. Tasks with progress.

    Every finished Pomodoro is added to its task.

  4. Growth.

    Time invested turns into skill levels.

Technical side: The same timer runs on desktop and phone, a small window above other apps, a command palette and full keyboard use.

  • Timer on every device
  • Keyboard shortcuts
  • Analytics and CSV export
  • Accessibility
  • Private server
